capabilities: clip selected page elements or dragged rectangles via Ctrl+Shift+X
append captured Markdown with source URL and capture time to the active note
authenticate the browser extension with a shared local token over 127.0.0.1
optionally translate selections via browser built-in, Baidu, Azure, Google Cloud, or OpenAI-compatible engines
prompt for a target file or new Clippings/ file when no Markdown note is active
disambiguation: Not a full-page web archiver; it captures selected elements or dragged rectangles only.
extras: Chrome installation requires Developer mode and loading an unpacked ZIP from GitHub releases; Edge installs from the add-ons store. Translation is off by default and cloud engines receive the selected text. README states the local receiver binds to 127.0.0.1 and no telemetry or remote service is used.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to clip selected elements from a web page into the note you are currently working in.
